sentences.text: AND AWARD DATED 05.11.2019 PASSED IN MVC NO.1150/2017 ON THE FILE OF THE SECOND ADDITIONAL SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND ADDITIONAL MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIMS TRIBUNAL, RANEBENNUR, AWARDING COMPENSATION OF Rs.2,10,000/- WITH INTEREST AT 9% P.A. FROM THE DATE OF PETITION TILL ITS REALISATION.
BETWEEN SRI. YALLAPPA S/O
RAMAPPA
MATTUR AGE.
33 YEARS, OCC.

PRIVATE EMPLOYEE IN GRASIM INDUSTRIES LTD., KUMARAPATTANAM, R/O. KARUR VILLAGE, TQ.
RANEBENNUR, DIST.
HAVERI.
...APPELLANT (BY SRI. ANJANEYA M, ADVOCATE) AND SMT. UMA G W/O K R CHETHAN AGE.

34 YEARS, OCC. HOUSEHOLD WORK, R/O. DONNEHALLI VILLAGE, JAGALORE TALUK,
DIST. DAVANAGERE-577001.

...RESPONDENT (BY SRI. S.C. BHUTI, ADVOCATE) THIS MFA IS FILED U/S.173 (1) OF MOTOR VEHICLES ACT, AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 05.11.2019 PASSED IN MVC NO.1150/2017 ON THE FILE OF THE II ADDITIONAL SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND ADDITIONAL MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIMS TRIBUNAL, RANEBENNUR, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.

THESE APPEALS ARE COMING ON FOR CONCILIATION BEFORE LOK ADALAT AFTER BEING REFFERED BY THE COURT, THE FOLLOWING CONCILIATION ORDER IS PASSED:
CONCILIATION ORDER
The learned counsel for the claimant and respondent along with their counsel are present.
2. After prolonged negotiations, the matter is settled.

The claimant has agreed to receive and the respondent has agreed to pay a global compensation of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees Two Lakh only)
instead of Rs.2,10,000/- globally towards full and final settlement of the claim.
A joint Memo is filed on behalf of the parties to this effect.
Same is accepted.
3. The said amount shall be released in favour of the claimant digitally.
4. It is submitted that the respondent has already deposited a sum of Rs.1,05,000/- before this Court and she undertakes to deposit the balance amount of Rs.95,000/- as per the terms mentioned above.
5. Both the Miscellaneous First Appeals stand disposed of in terms of the Joint Memo.
The award of the Tribunal shall stand modified accordingly.
6. The amount in deposit be transmitted to the Tribunal.
Draw up the award accordingly.
Sri. Yallappa S/O Ramappa Mattur vs Smt. Uma G W/O K R Chethan
